images.screen: A · 막차 — remembering a forgotten passenger
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. First-person view standing in the aisle of an old subway car on the last train, one-point perspective down the length of the car to a closed end door. Warm sodium-amber light from ceiling strips, deep umber shadows, the windows on both sides are pure black void with nothing outside. Passengers sit on long rust-red benches on both sides, painted as soft, simplified silhouettes whose faces are blank and increasingly blurred with distance, like forgotten people. The nearest passenger on the right is in focus and her face is slowly resolving out of a blur. Beside her floats a translucent literary memory card in serif Korean type: a half-revealed name "김수연" with the last syllables still fogged, the line "초등학교 3학년 · 짝꿍", and a circular hold-to-remember ring. Top-left, a minimal line map whose stations are memories. Heavy film grain, soft bloom, painterly depth of field, melancholic and tender.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same one-point perspective down an empty subway car at the final station. The windows now glow a pale, washed cream-white instead of black; the end doors are open onto blinding light, and a single dark silhouette stands in the doorway, backlit. Every seat is empty, and on each seat a small left-behind object rests in soft shadow: a blue-sleeved eraser cut in half, a red scarf, a cassette tape, a navy umbrella, a baseball glove, an unsent envelope, a dodgeball, a brass house key. Desaturated sepia and warm grey palette, gentle bloom, heavy film grain, strong vignette. Large thin serif Korean title across the top "모두 내리셨습니다", and along the bottom a row of eight name plates, some glowing, two blurred and unreadable, with a quiet choice "내린다" / "한 바퀴 더". Elegiac, still, emotional ending beat. Name plates: the first plate reads "수연" and glows; the others read "지훈", "민수", "하은", "도윤", "지수", and two are blurred and unreadable.
